name: pr-review-toolkit
description: PR review workflow skills for Codex: parallel review passes, documented PR comments, and bounded fixes that share state through .pr-review-cache/pr-#.json.

interface.shortDescription: Run parallel Codex PR reviews, document findings in one canonical comment, and fix selected issues.
interface.longDescription: Codex skills for participating in the pr-review-toolkit workflow. codex-review-pass launches six read-only review subagents and returns a deduplicated bundle; pr-review-and-document publishes that bundle through the shared .pr-review-cache/pr-#.json contract; codex-fix-worker fixes selected findings.
defaultPrompt: Run a Codex PR review pass with six subagents.
Review this PR and document the results.
Fix one selected PR review issue.
Update the canonical PR review comment.
